notes.title: The first demo update
notes.notes:
First demo update is LIVE - black hole issue is fixed!


Hello everyone! 

First and foremost, thanks for all the wonderful reactions and bug reports! It really helped us tackle the critical problems. The most common report was the black hole issue, and good news— we fixed it! Furthermore, we improved the asteroid collision and water visibility, so you don't lose track of them as easily.



We're really happy with how the Curiosmos demo was received, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you!! It makes us extremely excited to expand the universe.



Cheers & lots of love,

Céline
